searchResults.title: Bob platform FAQ: pricing, security & more | HiBob
searchResults.highlight:
HiBob is the company behind Bob, the award-winning, modern people platform built for the AI era. Designed for today’s distributed, fast-moving organizations, Bob helps businesses transform how they manage their people while streamlining HR, payroll, and finance operations. Its modular, integrated approach combines powerful capabilities with an intuitive user experience, enabling companies to adapt, scale, and thrive in a rapidly evolving world of work.
...
Bob is an all-in-one platform that helps organizations manage people, processes, and workforce decisions through a single connected experience.
...
- Core: Provides the operational foundation that keeps people, workflows, and decisions aligned across the business
- Talent: Runs performance reviews, structures feedback, and tracks employee growth
- Payroll, Planning & Finance: Syncs HR updates directly with payroll to prevent errors, models workforce costs, and helps leaders make data-backed decisions
- AI Companion: Uses a built-in AI assistant to summarize performance reviews, draft constructive feedback, and instantly analyze company data to save everyone time
...
Bob is a modern HCM platform that helps organizations manage, engage, develop, and plan for their workforce through a single, connected system. It delivers the core HRIS foundation companies need, while extending into talent, payroll, workforce planning, compensation, and analytics.
...
Bob includes the core capabilities organizations need to manage people, processes, and workforce decisions in a connected HCM platform. Its main modules include:
...
- Core, people data, job architecture (job catalog), skills visibility, workflows, and foundational people operations
- Payroll for managing payroll within the same connected system
- Hiring to attract and hire talent
- Talent Management for performance, growth, and employee development
- Learning for employee training and upskilling
- Workforce Planning for planning headcount and organizational needs
- Compensation for managing pay and reward strategies
- Analytics for workforce reporting and insights
- AI-powered capabilities to help teams work smarter and make faster decisions
...
Bob offers 100+ integrations designed to connect employee data and workflows across broader business systems. This includes integrations with applicant tracking systems like Greenhouse and Teamtailor, identity and access management tools like Okta, Entra ID, and OneLogin, collaboration tools like Slack, Microsoft Teams, and Google Workspace, and payroll, finance, scheduling, learning, and automation platforms such as ADP, NetSuite, Deputy, 360Learning, and Workato.
...
Bob combines core HR, talent, payroll, workforce planning, compensation, and analytics in one connected HCM, rather than relying on disconnected tools—built around an intuitive experience that helps teams manage the full employee lifecycle with less complexity. HR teams choose Bob over Rippling when they want HR depth and configurability rather than broad IT and device management; over Workday when they want faster implementation and easier day-to-day management without enterprise overhead; and over BambooHR or Personio when they’re scaling and need more customization, global support, and native US and UK payroll. For full comparisons, see our comparison guides.
...
Bob is worth it when you need more than a basic HR system. Bob brings together core HR, talent, payroll, workforce planning, compensation, and analytics into a single connected platform, helping teams replace disconnected tools and manage the full employee lifecycle more efficiently. It is also positioned around an intuitive user experience and faster time to value. With Bob, companies gain broader capabilities, greater scalability, and fewer compromises as their business grows. Bob is a stronger long-term investment for companies that want a modern, future-ready HCM rather than a basic point solution.
